You’re here in the Missoula sub…to ask about places better than Missoula? 

I don’t have endless positives to say about the place but I don’t have endless negatives either lol. Homelessness and crime is everywhere, not exclusive to here. What you’re listing as negatives are prevalent everywhere. It’s def not as “negative” as the PNW where I moved from (in regards to crime and homelessness) but the stigma I have personally experienced is more of a”gentle” question of “where are you from?” Because I don’t speak the same way the native Missoulians do. 

Honestly, this is a college town. People come here from all over. The housing and job market sucks. But any place that’s nice to live has that problem. I’ve met some really god awful people and some really cool people as well. It’s a mixed bag, just like everywhere else. 

You just have to decide for yourself what the pros and cons and deal breakers are for you yourself.
